name: aiwrapper
description: A Universal AI Wrapper for JavaScript & TypeScript
author: Dmitry Kury (https://dkury.com)

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run check:package
scripts.check:demo: npm --prefix chat run check && npm --prefix chat run build
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run integration --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:lang: npm run build && vitest run tests/lang
scripts.test:tools: npm run build && vitest run tests/tools
scripts.test:agents: npm run build && vitest run tests/agents
scripts.test:img-in: npm run build && vitest run tests/img-in
scripts.test:img-out: npm run build && vitest run tests/img-out
scripts.test:model: npm run build && vitest run tests/model.integration.test.ts
